cl_daily.source: Yahoo Finance CL=F daily OHLC (yfinance), finished NYMEX sessions only

ovx_yahoo.source: Yahoo Finance ^OVX daily close (yfinance), finished sessions only

config.evaluation: every OOS day (overlapping 5-session targets), plus each weekday grid on its own

conformal.method: adaptive conformal inference (Gibbs-Candes 2021) with 5-session delayed feedback

config.forecasts: losses and VaR use variance-consistent forecasts (log models scaled by exp(s^2)); direction and intervals use median forecasts

models.label: Persistence (RV5)
models.description: Next week's vol equals the last 5 sessions' realized vol.

models.label: Implied vol (raw OVX)
models.description: OVX itself (previous session's close) as the forecast: no fitting.

models.label: EWMA (RiskMetrics)
models.description: Exponentially weighted variance, lambda 0.94, all returns since 2000.

models.label: GARCH(1,1)-t
models.description: Student-t GARCH(1,1), refit weekly on all returns since 2000.

models.label: GJR-GARCH(1,1)-t
models.description: Asymmetric (leverage) GARCH, Student-t, refit weekly.

models.label: HAR-RV
models.description: Log-HAR on 5/22/66-session close-to-close realized vol (Corsi 2009).

models.label: HAR-RV + semivariance
models.description: HAR-RV plus 5-session downside semivolatility (Patton-Sheppard 2015).

models.label: HAR-range
models.description: Log-HAR on a range-based measure: Rogers-Satchell plus squared overnight return.

models.label: Implied-vol regression
models.description: Log-regression of next-week realized vol on OVX alone.

models.label: HAR-IV (model of record)
models.description: Log-HAR on 5/22/66-session realized vol plus OVX; the production model.

models.label: HAR-IV, same-day OVX (v1 timing)
models.description: HAR-IV with the test day's own OVX close, which settles ~1h45m after CL: overlaps the target.

models.label: HAR-IV-range
models.description: HAR-IV with the range-based realized measure in place of close-to-close.

models.label: LightGBM
models.description: Gradient-boosted trees on all of the above features, retrained quarterly.

models.label: Combination
models.description: Equal-weight pool of the variances of HAR-IV, GJR-GARCH-t and the implied-vol regression.

spa_qlike_vs_har_iv.note: excludes the same-day-OVX variant, which uses information the model of record may not

oos_selection.rule: each day, the lowest trailing 156-week QLIKE over matured outcomes; HAR-IV for the first 52 weeks

noise_floor.process: i.i.d. Student-t(5), constant volatility (nothing to forecast)
noise_floor.note: For any continuous i.i.d. series, calling 'up' exactly when the current 5-session vol is below its median is right with probability E[max(U, 1-U)] = 75%.
